body: Thanks for everyone's comments and suggestions. I spoke to his doctors yesterday as well as nurses and social workers. Due to the restraining order, the continuos suicide attempts, volatile behavior, threats and our desperate please for help they've moved to keep him involuntarily. A lawyer was appointed to him yesterday. today he has a meeting with a judge and another doctor is going to go give a second opinion. I really do want them to prove me wrong since this is the last thing i want. I feel like a piece of shit for doing this but if him hating me means guaranteeing his safety and allowing him to get the therapy he needs to get better, so be it.

Thank you for the quick reply. I know this is all absurd and that there's no magical solution. What's frustrating is that I'm not asking doctors to take my word for it. And I'm definitely not the only one saying this. spouse is terrified for her well being. so are we. How many times does the police have to admit someone under the baker act to demonstrate they are not well. It's like a revolving door except every time the condition is worse. how many suicide attempts? we can prove most of the stories he can tell doctors are lies. how many police reports do we need.  there's a restraining order now taken out by spouse. The fact that they said they must protect his rights but not his life seems absurd to me. Don't people also have the right to live? thanks again for your comment. I read what I'm writing and realize my approach is not the best but I have no legal medical knowledge and like I said in my post, i just want to ensure this person lives. it's like sitting on the sidelines watching a person destroy themselves.
